timing=icount shift=3,sleep=off
cpu=default
bin=target/x86_64-unknown-none/release/bootimage-aetheros_kernel.bin

# Who pays for a wrong compiler hint? (F19) Generated by gen_asymmetry.py.
# Each line: one mislabelled corpus program + p_int (interactive) + p_cpu (hog).
# hNNN_c.axe carries the counted analysis's hint, hNNN_s.axe the safe one's.
# PREDICTIONS, WRITTEN BEFORE RUNNING:
#   Y1. LIGHT programs under hint with their (too-light, interactive) counted
#       hint: p_int's p95 wake-up latency > 1 ms in every case -- the neighbour
#       pays.
#   Y2. HEAVY programs under hint with their (too-heavy, cpu) safe hint: the
#       program's OWN p95 > 1 ms in every case, while p_int's stays <= 100 us --
#       the program pays, not the neighbour.
#   Y3. Under hfair, whatever the hint, p_int's p95 <= 100 us in every line.
# LIGHT: h018 (counted interactive, safe io), h074 (counted interactive, safe io), h085 (counted interactive, safe cpu), h117 (counted interactive, safe cpu), h126 (counted interactive, safe cpu)
repeat 3 bench files:h018_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h018_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h018_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h018_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h074_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h074_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h074_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h074_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h085_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h085_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h085_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h085_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h117_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h117_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h117_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h117_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h126_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h126_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h126_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h126_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
# HEAVY: h025 (counted interactive, safe cpu), h050 (counted interactive, safe cpu), h073 (counted interactive, safe cpu), h076 (counted interactive, safe cpu), h082 (counted interactive, safe cpu)
repeat 3 bench files:h025_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h025_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h025_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h025_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h050_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h050_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h050_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h050_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h073_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h073_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h073_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h073_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h076_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h076_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h076_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h076_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h082_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h082_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hint
repeat 3 bench files:h082_c.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
repeat 3 bench files:h082_s.axe+p_int.axe+p_cpu.axe hfair
poweroff
